'''Kreet'ah''' was a [[Kian'thar]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] during [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] time.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Biography==
Kreet'ah had been trained from birth for criminal leadership by [[Shal'mak]] his mother,<ref name="TCSWE" /> who ruled a criminal network as a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] of [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Because of this, was raised by his [[Kreet'ah's father|father]] working in their [[derlac]] farm on his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Shaum Hii/Legends|Shaum Hii]], corralling the [[Cattle/Legends|cattle]] with a [[Derlac whistle|whistle]] as well as selling them for export.<ref name="SotES" />

As his mother served [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] well, and Kreet'ah showed a talent in character judgment, Xizor allowed him to inherit her position; thus Kreet'ah became one more in a long series of Kian'thars who served Black Sun; just as his [[Kreet'ah's daughter|daughter]] was in line to inherit his position from him.<ref name="SotES" />

Thanks to his corporate experience from his youth with his father, Kreet'ah used a vast network of spies to infiltrate the megacorporations that worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Not only he provided much vital information to [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] about companies, but his contacts also stole secrets, misrouted shipments, and even blackmailed corrupt executives. Kreet'ah's network expanded to [[Galentro Heavy Works]], [[Dynamic Automata]], [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]],<ref name="SotES" /> and [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]].

A company secretly backed by Black Sun, attempted a takeover of [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation]], which aggressively resisted it. As a result, Kreet'ah sabotaged that company around [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] causing economic difficulties.<ref name="SotES" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' during that time.</ref> Xizor summoned all his Vigos to [[Xizor's Palace|his Palace]], and they all complied. They all gathered in the antechamber, and were relieved of their weapons by [[Howzmin]]. Everyone knew that Xizor discovered something and wanted to make an example of the culprit to the remaining eight of them. As for Kreet'ah, he accepted the logic of annihilating incompetent allies, even if it had to be himself, although he knew that Xizor was satisfied with his management, and the problem would be with someone who did a really serious offiense; he waited patiently until they were summoned by [[Guri]].<ref>{{WEGCite|story=The Obvious Scapegoat|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref> At the conclusion of the meeting, Kreet'ah witnessed as Xizor had Guri [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Green]] in front of the other Vigos, as a message to any Vigos who would try to sell information.<ref name="guri">{{Topps|set=1996 Topps Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire|cardname=Beautiful... and Lethal|link=https://www.rebelscum.com/photo.asp?image=/sote/soteTC009.jpg}}</ref><ref name="novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Kreet'ah spent his youth gaining corporate experience, which formed his later mindset and focus during his criminal career. He kept dressing as a rancher from his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], and kept a stern and businesslike attitude, not speaking his mind when not asked to, and not bothering with the intra-Vigo game of intrigue.<ref name="SotES" />
